threat_event: An organized criminal group compromises the POS and reservation systems through a vendor remote tool and steals card data at scale
threat_source: Organized cybercriminal group targeting hospitality payments
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor-managed remote tools outside PAM at 37 hotels; legacy POS with clear-text card data in memory at 41 hotels; franchised segments could reach the CRS integration tier (see R-003, R-005, R-007)
existing_controls: Tokenized vault; P2PE at 82 front desks and 153 outlets; 24x7 SOC; EDR on cloud POS and PCs; PAM for most vendors
treatment_plan: Move the 5 vendors into PAM (POAM-005); replace the legacy POS (POAM-001); fix the hub rule and test segmentation every six months (POAM-004); exercise the card compromise runbook with the disclosure committee (POAM-014)
key_risk_indicator: Hotels with vendor tools outside PAM; outlets on legacy POS; days since last segmentation test

threat_event: Ransomware encrypts CRS integrations, PMS interfaces, and hotel systems across many hotels
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Large attack surface (21,000 endpoints, 520 hotels on the managed network); legacy systems at hotels; franchisee-operated networks
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-01; SYS-02 interfaces; SYS-05; SYS-10; SYS-11; P05 BP-01, BP-02, BP-04
regulatory_driver: N72-R01 (PCI DSS 5.2; 12.10.1); N72-R04; SEC Form 8-K Item 1.05
existing_controls: 24x7 SOC; EDR on 97% of company endpoints; immutable backups; annual DR test met CRS and vault RTOs; cyber insurance
treatment_plan: EDR on legacy POS replacements (POAM-001); remove vendor tools (POAM-005); resort migration (POAM-002); annual enterprise ransomware exercise with the disclosure committee (POAM-014)
key_risk_indicator: EDR coverage; mean time to contain; DR test results

threat_event: Attacker uses a vendor-managed remote tool outside PAM to reach legacy POS, door lock, or building systems at company-operated hotels
threat_source: Cybercriminal group using stolen vendor credentials
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 5 of 14 property-system vendors use always-on remote tools without company MFA or session recording at 37 hotels
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-04 legacy POS; SYS-11 lock servers and building management
existing_controls: Remote tool inventory; vendor contracts with security terms; network monitoring at hubs
treatment_plan: Move all vendor access to PAM and block the tools at hotel firewalls (POAM-005)
key_risk_indicator: Hotels with vendor tools outside PAM (target 0)

threat_event: The 9 resorts on the seller's systems suffer an outage longer than the RTO or a compromise through the unfederated seller directory
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Transition services agreement RTO 24 h and nightly backups; manual terminations; seller network not monitored by the SOC
existing_controls: Transition services agreement with security terms; weekly seller status calls; resorts added to 2026 merchant ROC scope
treatment_plan: Migrate the 9 resorts to the brand PMS, network, and identity platform (POAM-002; POAM-003); interim daily termination reconciliation
key_risk_indicator: Resorts migrated; late terminations at resorts

threat_event: Memory-scraping malware on legacy POS workstations captures card data at food and beverage outlets
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Card data in clear text in POS workstation memory and on the hotel network; no EDR on legacy POS workstations
existing_controls: Vendor anti-malware; hotel firewalls; quarterly scans
treatment_plan: Replace with cloud POS and validated P2PE (POAM-001); interim application allow-listing on legacy workstations

threat_event: A compromise at a franchised hotel (stolen franchisee credential or franchisee network) is used to reach CRS and PMS data for many hotels
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 26,400 franchisee staff accounts; 230 franchisee-operated networks with no company visibility; brand standards set no technical minimums
existing_controls: MFA for all franchisee users since 2025-02; hotel-scoped PMS roles; SOC monitoring of PMS and CRS exports
treatment_plan: Technical minimums in brand standards; AOC enforcement; franchisee account inactivity job (POAM-012; POAM-008); behavior analytics (P02 AC-2(12))
key_risk_indicator: Franchisee AOC submission rate; inactive franchisee accounts

threat_event: An attacker on a franchised hotel network moves through the managed network hub to the CRS integration tier
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One hub rule let franchised segments reach the CRS integration tier on 2 ports; service provider segmentation test overdue
existing_controls: Hub firewalls; rule removed 2026-06-02 pending verification; network detection at hubs
treatment_plan: Verify the rule removal, review all hub rules, and test segmentation every six months (POAM-004)
key_risk_indicator: Days since last segmentation test; hub rule exceptions

threat_event: A malicious script on a resort booking microsite skims card numbers as guests type them
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 3 resort microsites on the seller's hosting with no payment page script inventory or tamper detection
treatment_plan: Move the microsites to the brand booking engine; interim script monitoring (POAM-015)
key_risk_indicator: Payment pages without script monitoring (3 today)

threat_event: A door lock server is compromised or fails, so rooms cannot be secured or guests cannot enter
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 31 lock servers on unsupported operating systems; lock vendors use remote tools outside PAM
existing_controls: Emergency master key procedure; lock servers on the hotel back office segment
treatment_plan: Upgrade or replace the 31 lock servers; isolate lock servers on their own segment (POAM-009)

threat_event: Credential stuffing takes over loyalty accounts; points are redeemed and member profiles exposed
threat_source: Fraud ring using breached password lists
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: MFA optional (23% adoption); sign-in with email and password; points redeemable for stays and gift cards
existing_controls: Bot detection; rate limits; fraud team review of large redemptions
treatment_plan: Require MFA or passkeys for redemptions and profile changes; risk-based sign-in; breached-password screening (POAM-017)
key_risk_indicator: Account takeover cases per month; points fraud losses ($1.9 million in 2026 Q2)

threat_event: Card numbers stored in group sales and events mailboxes are stolen after a mailbox compromise
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 4,800 emails with card numbers at managed hotels; 29 hotels accept emailed card authorization forms
affected_asset_or_process: Productivity suite; managed hotel sales teams
existing_controls: Email security; MFA on mail; data discovery scans
treatment_plan: Purge stored card data; replace card forms with secure payment links; block outbound card numbers in mail (POAM-006)
owner: Director of Payments and PCI Compliance
key_risk_indicator: Emails with card numbers found per scan

threat_event: The revenue-management system pools non-public rate and occupancy data from competing hotels, creating antitrust exposure
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Benchmarking clause pools data across the company's hotels and the 212 independently owned franchised hotels that subscribe
treatment_plan: Opt out of pooled benchmarking; separate franchisee data; counsel review of the franchise pricing service (POAM-020)
key_risk_indicator: Hotels sharing data into pooled benchmarks

threat_event: Rates are displayed without the mandatory resort or destination fee in the chatbot, resort microsites, or channel feeds
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Resort fees not loaded in chatbot knowledge sources and resort microsite feeds after the acquisition
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-06 chatbot; resort microsites; channel feeds
existing_controls: Total price on the brand website and app since 2025-05
treatment_plan: Load fees in all feeds; chatbot total price rule; quarterly price display tests (POAM-021)

threat_event: AI use cases run without AI governance committee review
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 4 of 12 use cases not reviewed; AI features switched on in vendor products
treatment_plan: Review the 4 use cases by 2026-11-30; procurement block on AI features without an inventory ID (POAM-020)

threat_event: A material incident is disclosed late or inaccurately because the materiality process fails under pressure
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Playbook not exercised with 3 new disclosure committee members; no guidance for franchise-originated incidents
regulatory_driver: SEC Form 8-K Item 1.05; SEC Reg S-K Item 106
existing_controls: Materiality playbook; outside securities counsel on retainer
treatment_plan: Update playbook; brief new members; full tabletop 2026-11-12 (POAM-014)
key_risk_indicator: Tabletop completed; time from declaration to determination in exercises

threat_event: Guest profile hub data (61 million profiles, 8.7 million with ID numbers) is exfiltrated
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Large data store kept indefinitely; bulk export roles; copies in the warehouse
existing_controls: Export limited to 3 roles; egress monitoring; encryption at rest
treatment_plan: Retention schedule and purge (POAM-018); export anomaly detection (P02 AC-2(12))
key_risk_indicator: Profiles past retention; large exports investigated

threat_event: The 2026 merchant ROC finds requirements not in place, leading to acquirer action and higher fees
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Legacy POS, resort systems, and card data in email are in scope for the first time or newly found
existing_controls: Compensating controls documented in 2025; QSA pre-assessment
treatment_plan: Close POAM-001, POAM-004, POAM-006, and POAM-015 or document compensating controls before fieldwork
owner: Director of Payments and PCI Compliance
key_risk_indicator: Requirements without evidence before QSA fieldwork

threat_event: A franchisee that has not validated PCI DSS suffers a card breach that is attributed to the brand
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 141 franchisees did not submit 2025 AOCs; no technical minimums for 230 hotels off the managed network
existing_controls: Brand standard requires annual AOC; reminders
treatment_plan: Default notices and fee holds for missing AOCs; technical minimums; managed network incentives (POAM-012)
owner: Executive Vice President, Franchise Operations and Development

threat_event: A hotel user with the card display permission misuses virtual card numbers
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 1,340 users hold the permission against about 420 needed
existing_controls: Display events logged and reviewed by automation
treatment_plan: Remove the permission from about 920 users; monthly review (POAM-007)

threat_event: An inactive franchisee account is taken over and used to read reservations
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 1,912 franchisee accounts inactive more than 90 days still enabled
treatment_plan: Inactivity job and quarterly franchisee attestation (POAM-008)
owner: Director of Identity and Access Management

threat_event: A privileged cloud credential is misused to read the vault
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Small number of vault administrators
existing_controls: PAM just-in-time access; FIDO2; dual control; session recording
treatment_plan: Accept with existing controls; review in 12 months
owner: Director of Payments and PCI Compliance

threat_event: Vault encryption keys are compromised
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Keys in hardware security modules with split knowledge
existing_controls: HSM-protected keys; dual control; annual key ceremony audit
treatment_plan: Accept; annual review
owner: Director of Payments and PCI Compliance

threat_event: A phishing email compromises a corporate or hotel user account
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Large, high-turnover hotel workforce
treatment_plan: Phishing-resistant MFA for finance and payments roles

threat_event: Business email compromise redirects an owner remittance or vendor payment
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Owner remittances for 72 managed hotels; many vendors
existing_controls: Call-back verification for bank changes; dual approval
treatment_plan: Payment change verification in the ERP

threat_event: The brand PMS vendor suffers a breach or extended outage affecting 741 hotels
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single vendor for 741 hotels
existing_controls: Vendor AOC and SOC 2 Type 2; contract RTO 4 h; downtime reports
treatment_plan: Quarterly vendor security reviews; contract notice term of 24 hours; joint exercise

threat_event: The payment gateway suffers a breach at the provider
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One gateway for about 92% of card volume
existing_controls: Gateway AOC; tokens are company-held; contract liability terms
treatment_plan: Contract indemnity and cyber insurance; annual review
owner: Director of Payments and PCI Compliance

threat_event: The distribution switch is compromised and sends altered reservations or exposes virtual cards
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Mutual TLS interface; switch AOC
existing_controls: Mutual TLS; message validation; switch AOC
treatment_plan: Annual interface review

threat_event: A payment gateway outage stops CRS guarantees and prepaid bookings
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Secondary gateway covers front desk terminals only
treatment_plan: Extend secondary gateway to CRS guarantees
owner: Director of Payments and PCI Compliance

threat_event: A cloud region outage takes the CRS down
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Active-passive design across two regions
treatment_plan: Accept; annual DR test

threat_event: Malicious code arrives in a trusted POS or PMS vendor software update
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor updates pushed to hotels and the tenant
existing_controls: Staged rollouts for cloud POS; vendor SOC reports
treatment_plan: Staged rollout for all hotel software; software bill of materials requests from tier-1 vendors

threat_event: A zero-day in a hotel firewall or remote access edge device is exploited
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 110 hotel firewall pairs plus hub edges
treatment_plan: 72-hour emergency patch target for edge devices

threat_event: A SOX IT general control fails in owner accounting or franchise fee billing
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Fee billing uses CRS and PMS revenue data
treatment_plan: Automated reconciliation of fee data

threat_event: A hurricane affects Florida hotels and colocation DC-1
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 118 Florida hotels; DC-1 in Florida
existing_controls: Hub failover to DC-2; hotel hurricane plans; cellular backup
treatment_plan: Annual hurricane-season failover drill in May

threat_event: Power or cooling fails at a colocation hub
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Dual hubs
treatment_plan: Accept

threat_event: A rogue wireless access point is connected to a payment segment
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Wireless intrusion detection at company-operated hotels
treatment_plan: Accept

threat_event: A payment terminal at a legacy outlet is tampered with or swapped
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Inspections missed in 7 of 25 sampled weeks; device lists incomplete
existing_controls: Inspections at cloud POS outlets; tamper-evident devices
treatment_plan: Inspection schedule in the POS app; complete device lists (POAM-013)

threat_event: Paper card authorization forms at hotels are stolen
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 29 hotels file forms
treatment_plan: Secure payment links replace forms (POAM-006)

threat_event: Vendor default credentials on legacy POS back-office servers are used to take control of POS
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Default credentials found at 3 hotels in P07 testing
treatment_plan: Credential sweep at all 41 legacy hotels; verification (POAM-010)

threat_event: Attackers on guest Wi-Fi target guests' devices
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared guest networks
treatment_plan: Annual guest network review

threat_event: An attacker pivots from the IPTV or building management system to hotel back office networks
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor tools outside PAM; building systems on shared segments at some hotels
treatment_plan: Segment building systems (POAM-005 scope)
key_risk_indicator: Hotels with building systems on shared segments

threat_event: Staff paste guest or card data into unapproved generative AI tools
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Easy access to public AI tools
treatment_plan: Block unapproved AI domains at the web gateway

threat_event: Mobile check-in face matching misidentifies guests or biometric data is handled outside policy
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Face templates computed from selfies by the ID verification vendor
existing_controls: Consent screen; templates deleted within 24 hours by contract; disabled in Illinois
treatment_plan: Accuracy testing by age and skin tone; counsel review of state biometric laws (POAM-020)

threat_event: The applicant screening tool screens out qualified candidates in a discriminatory way
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Live at 22 hotels without review; no adverse impact analysis
treatment_plan: Keep ranking off until review and adverse impact analysis
key_risk_indicator: Hiring decisions using AI ranking (0 since 2026-08-20)

threat_event: A caller tricks the contact center or a front desk into changing a reservation or revealing guest details
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 650 agents and hotel front desks
treatment_plan: Verification codes for reservation changes

threat_event: A hotel employee steals guest data for fraud
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Hotel-scoped access; high turnover
treatment_plan: Behavior analytics (P02 AC-2(12))

threat_event: Indefinite retention of guest profiles and ID numbers makes any breach far larger
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No deletion of 61 million profiles
treatment_plan: Retention schedule: register data 2 years minimum (Fla. Stat. 509.101(2)); ID numbers deleted 30 days after checkout (POAM-018)

threat_event: A lost staff laptop exposes guest data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Encrypted laptops
treatment_plan: Accept

threat_event: Legacy POS workstations on an unsupported operating system are exploited
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 6 hotels run an out-of-support OS on legacy POS workstations
treatment_plan: Replace first at the 6 hotels (POAM-001)

threat_event: Critical vulnerabilities on legacy POS stay open past target
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor-controlled patching
treatment_plan: Vendor patch commitments; compensating rules (POAM-016)

threat_event: An attacker deletes or corrupts backups before ransomware
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Immutable separate accounts
existing_controls: Write-once locks; separate accounts; offline copy
treatment_plan: Accept

threat_event: The service provider segmentation test is missed again
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No scheduling control for six-month tests
treatment_plan: Six-month test calendar in the GRC platform (POAM-004)

threat_event: Gaps in log collection from legacy POS and resort systems delay detection of a compromise
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No SIEM feeds from 41 legacy POS servers and the 9 resorts
treatment_plan: SIEM collectors (POAM-011)
key_risk_indicator: Log sources not in the SIEM

threat_event: Guest data copied to the warehouse is exfiltrated
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Analysts with broad warehouse access
existing_controls: Tokens and hashed identifiers only for card data; access reviews
treatment_plan: Minimize guest fields in the warehouse

threat_event: Chat transcripts with card numbers are stored outside the vault
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Chatbot transcripts
treatment_plan: Purge historical transcripts

threat_event: Assurance is unreliable because an assessor also designed or configured the controls it tests
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: QSA and co-source independence handled case by case
regulatory_driver: N72-R01 (PCI DSS 12.4); SEC Reg S-K Item 106(b)(1)(ii)
existing_controls: New QSA firm for 2026; in-house re-performance of PAM tests
treatment_plan: Write independence rules into the internal audit charter and QSA selection procedure (POAM-019)

threat_event: The company is not ready for its first CCPA cybersecurity audit
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: First report due 2028-04-01
treatment_plan: Gap assessment against the audit regulation by 2027-06-30 (POAM-022)

threat_event: Automated pricing raises rates beyond lawful limits during a declared state of emergency
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No emergency cap in the revenue-management rules
existing_controls: Revenue managers can freeze rates manually
treatment_plan: Automatic emergency cap and human approval in declared areas (POAM-020)

threat_event: Card-testing attacks on the booking engine cause fraud losses and chargebacks
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Public booking engine payment form
treatment_plan: Tune velocity rules; challenge suspicious sessions

threat_event: Unencrypted card data inside hotel networks at 41 hotels is captured by a compromised device on the same segment
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Legacy POS clear-text traffic; shared segments at 9 hotels
treatment_plan: Isolate legacy POS at the 9 hotels now; replace (POAM-001)

threat_event: The response to an incident that starts at a franchised hotel is slow or confused
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Runbook roles for franchisee incidents not exercised
treatment_plan: Franchise track in the P08 runbook; exercise with 3 franchisees (POAM-014)

threat_event: A future acquisition closes without security due diligence and integration funding
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: The resort deal did not budget integration
treatment_plan: Security due diligence checklist in deal approvals

threat_event: The seller under the transition services agreement does not report an incident on time
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: TSA notice term 72 hours
treatment_plan: Weekly attestations until migration (POAM-002)

threat_event: An owner of a managed hotel changes merchant accounts or terminals without company review
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Owner-held merchant accounts
treatment_plan: Accept

threat_event: High hotel staff turnover leaves untrained staff handling card data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Turnover above 60% in some roles
treatment_plan: Short card handling module in the first week
